**STEP 1 - Scene:** This is a fresh fruit plate with cantaloupe chunks, strawberries, raspberries, blackberries and blueberries. There is no dressing.

**STEP 2 - Vessel:** It is a large square white plate, about 24–25 cm per side. Its area is roughly equivalent to a 26 cm dinner plate, so about 530 cm².

**STEP 3 - Items:** I can see these foods:
- Cantaloupe chunks (about 8 pieces)
- Strawberries (3 halves or pieces)
- Raspberries (2)
- Blackberries (about 2–3, clustered)
- Blueberries (about 10)

**STEP 4 - Area:** Food covers about 24% of the plate.

| Item | Share of plate | Area |
|---|---|---|
| Cantaloupe | 13% | 69 cm² |
| Strawberries | 5% | 27 cm² |
| Blackberries | 2% | 11 cm² |
| Raspberries | 2% | 11 cm² |
| Blueberries | 2% | 11 cm² |

**STEPS 5–7 - Volume, grams and energy:**

| Item | Volume | Grams (density) | Energy |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cantaloupe | 69 cm² × 1.7 cm = 117 ml | × 0.65 = 76 g | × 34 kcal/100 g = 26 kcal |
| Strawberries | 27 cm² × 2.2 cm = 59 ml | × 0.6 = 36 g | × 32 kcal/100 g = 12 kcal |
| Blackberries | 11 cm² × 2 cm = 22 ml | × 0.6 = 13 g | × 43 kcal/100 g = 6 kcal |
| Raspberries | 11 cm² × 2 cm = 22 ml | × 0.5 = 11 g | × 52 kcal/100 g = 6 kcal |
| Blueberries | 11 cm² × 1.5 cm = 17 ml | × 0.7 = 12 g | × 57 kcal/100 g = 7 kcal |

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** The total is about 148 g and 57 kcal. That is plausible for a small fruit plate with roughly eight melon chunks and a handful of berries.
